LESSON: CARING FOR ENERGY ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the
Topic 3.5: Caring For Energy environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Caring For Energy environment. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples
2. describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment
3. practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment
4. tell why Caring For Energy environment matters for life in Kenya

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CARING FOR ENERGY ENVIRONMENT
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Caring For Energy environment helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: CARING FOR ENERGY ENVIRONMENT
Caring For Energy environment is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.
Use safe examples only. Do not try dangerous experiments without a teacher.
Write definitions in your own words, then add one drawing or real-life example.

PART 1: Explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Caring For Energy environment” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment

What this means
In this part you learn to describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Caring For Energy environment matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment

What this means
In this part you learn to practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Apply: Describe one safe action you can take related to Caring For Energy environment this week.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Tell why Caring For Energy environment matters for life in Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to tell why Caring For Energy environment matters for life in Kenya. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: tell why Caring For Energy environment matters for life in Kenya.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Caring For Energy environment” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can tell why Caring For Energy environment matters for life in Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Caring For Energy environment is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Caring For Energy environment” around your school. (skill: explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples)

Example 2: Say why Caring For Energy environment matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment)

Example 3: Describe one safe action you can take related to Caring For Energy environment this week. (skill: practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment)

Example 4: Name what you can see/touch about “Caring For Energy environment” around your school. (skill: tell why Caring For Energy environment matters for life in Kenya)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Caring For Energy environment to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples.
3. Practise this skill: describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment.
4. Practise this skill: practise one safe skill connected to Caring For Energy environment.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Caring For Energy environment from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Caring For Energy environment: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Caring For Energy environment?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Caring For Energy environment means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Caring For Energy environment means using everyday Kenyan examples.
5. Be able to: describe how Caring For Energy environment appears at home, school, or in the environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
